publisher: NOAA / National Weather Service / Weather Prediction Center

referenceQueryDecoded.name: NWS States Borders
referenceQueryDecoded.interpretation: Map viewport/tile query with quantized geometry; no forecast threshold, probability or valid period. The WPC application references this same state-border layer.

forecastImages.units: percent chance of at least the selected liquid-equivalent precipitation threshold
forecastImages.selection: First available 24-hour key plus 24 and 48 forecast hours, where supported by the publisher cycle. Does not claim the archived slides' exact dates or 12Z boundaries.
forecastImages.displayCRS: EPSG:3857; publisher geographic corners projected to Web Mercator for linear image placement, matching the portal's map grid
forecastImages.coverage: Southwest CONUS tile, including Fresno County; north of 38.002106 degrees is outside this increment's image coverage.
forecastImages.style: Unmodified publisher PNG bytes, opacity 1, normal blend; exact publisher green probability legend with textual percentage labels.
forecastImages.access: Public NOAA files. CORS allows weather.gov, so scheduled GitHub Actions publishes only these public map images and provenance on Pages. No private features or credentials.
forecastImages.cadence: Existing Pages collection target: every 15 minutes, not a delivery guarantee. Open app checks its deployed manifest every five minutes.
forecastImages.guards: Failed/partial collection, cycle rollover, changed source bounds/colors, hash/dimension mismatch, unavailable period, cycle older than six hours, collection check older than two hours, or ended forecast withholds shading.
forecastImages.comparison: Latest WPC portal cycle beside the original dated partner slide. Not proven to be the identical forecast cycle, local generation method or graphic used by Hanford.
